metadata.description: Update a payment link by ID.

acceptedPaymentMethods.label: Accepted Payment Methods
acceptedPaymentMethods.description: An array of strings indicating the accepted payment methods. Valid values include 'CREDIT_OR_DEBIT_CARD', 'ACH', 'SEPA', 'BACS', and 'PADS'.

additionalFormFields.label: Additional Form Fields
additionalFormFields.description: An array of PaymentLinkFormField objects representing additional form fields for the payment link.

automatedSalesTaxEnabled.label: Automated Sales Tax Enabled
automatedSalesTaxEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether automated sales tax is enabled.

businessUnitId.label: Business Unit Id
businessUnitId.description: An object representing the business unit ID associated with the payment link.

collectFullBillingAddress.label: Collect Full Billing Address
collectFullBillingAddress.description: A boolean indicating whether to collect the full billing address during checkout.

collectShippingAddress.label: Collect Shipping Address
collectShippingAddress.description: A boolean indicating whether to collect the shipping address during checkout.

currencyCode.label: Currency Code
currencyCode.description: The currency code for the payment link, represented as a string.

dealConfigurations.label: Deal Configurations
dealConfigurations.description: An object containing deal configuration settings.

descriptionHtml.label: Description Html
descriptionHtml.description: An object containing the HTML description of the payment link.

label.label: Label
label.description: A descriptive label for the discount. This is a string.

value.label: Value
value.description: The numerical value of the discount to be applied. This is a number.

valueType.label: Value Type
valueType.description: The type of discount value, which can either be 'FIXED' or 'PERCENT'.

discountCodeEnabled.label: Discount Code Enabled
discountCodeEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether discount codes are enabled for the payment link.

discountObjectId.label: Discount Object Id
discountObjectId.description: An object representing the discount object ID associated with the payment link.

discountObjectIds.label: Discount Object Ids
discountObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of discount objects associated with the payment link.

domainId.label: Domain Id
domainId.description: An object representing the domain ID associated with the payment link.

enableDefaultCheckoutFees.label: Enable Default Checkout Fees
enableDefaultCheckoutFees.description: A boolean indicating whether default checkout fees are enabled.

feeObjectIds.label: Fee Object Ids
feeObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of fee objects associated with the payment link.

fees.label: Fees
fees.description: An array of FeeRequest objects representing the fees associated with the payment link.

includeEmailInSuccessRedirect.label: Include Email In Success Redirect
includeEmailInSuccessRedirect.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the email in the success redirect.

isOneTimeUseEnabled.label: Is One Time Use Enabled
isOneTimeUseEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether the payment link is enabled for one-time use.

lineItemObjectIds.label: Line Item Object Ids
lineItemObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of line item objects associated with the payment link.

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: An array of line item objects, which can be of types LineItemCustomCreateRequest, LineItemFromProductCreateRequest, or LineItemCloneCreateRequest.

paymentLinkName.label: Payment Link Name
paymentLinkName.description: The name of the payment link, represented as a string.

state.label: State
state.description: The state of the payment link, represented as a string. Valid values are 'ON' and 'OFF'.

storePaymentMethodAtCheckout.label: Store Payment Method At Checkout
storePaymentMethodAtCheckout.description: A boolean indicating whether the payment method should be stored at checkout.

successUrl.label: Success Url
successUrl.description: An object representing the success URL where the user is redirected after a successful transaction.

taxObjectIds.label: Tax Object Ids
taxObjectIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of tax objects associated with the payment link.

taxes.label: Taxes
taxes.description: An array of TaxRequest objects representing the taxes associated with the payment link.
